commit_message: [KAN-28] Golden capture: 32 fixtures + equivalence suite skeleton

violations.detail: The rewritten /api/risk-score handler builds its SQL query by interpolating the user-supplied req.query.ref value directly into a template literal string instead of using a parameterized query with a bound ? placeholder.

The req.query.ref value is passed to the SQL layer after only a truthiness check, with no type, length, or format validation at the route boundary via express-validator before it reaches the database.

The new computeRiskScore function and the rewritten app.get('/api/risk-score') route handler are both missing the required compliance header carrying Function, Owner, Control (NIST 800-53 id plus SOX/PCI reference), and Reviewed date.
Application code in server.js was changed but no change-log entry was added in this diff and no change-log directory exists in the repository (missing).

The diff modifies application code described as a modernisation but no plan documents (01-assessment.md, 02-plan.md, 03-decisions.md) exist in docs/modernization/ and none are added by this diff (missing plan).

The /api/risk-score endpoint is rewritten with a changed scoring function and a different response shape (round_amt dropped, over_approval_limit renamed to over_limit) but no golden fixtures, no equivalence test suite, and no plan-document entries authorizing the behavior differences are present in the diff or the repository.
SMTP_PASSWORD is hardcoded as a string literal 'meridian2026!' instead of being read from process.env.
STATUS_API_KEY is hardcoded as a string literal 'meridian-status-api-key-2026' instead of being read from process.env.
STATUS_API_BEARER is hardcoded as a string literal 'Bearer meridian-payops-notify-2026' instead of being read from process.env.
The /exceptions/:id/notify route builds SQL by string concatenation of req.params.id instead of using a parameterized query with a bound ? placeholder.
The /exceptions/:id/notify route uses req.params.id and req.query.to without any input validation before they reach the SQL query and the SMTP socket respectively.
notify.js has no required compliance header carrying Function, Owner, Control (NIST 800-53 id plus SOX/PCI reference), and Reviewed date.
The new app.get('/exceptions/:id/notify') route handler has no required compliance header carrying Function, Owner, Control, and Reviewed date.
Application code was changed but no change-log entry was added in this diff (missing).
